No account, no cloud, no tracking. A copy leaves this phone only when you export one, to the place you pick, or in Android\'s backup, end-to-end encrypted with your screen lock.

Android backs up Cycle only when this phone has a screen lock, so the backup is end-to-end encrypted. Until you set a PIN, pattern or password in your phone\'s settings, your days are only on this phone. To keep a copy, export your data.
Open Cycle with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
Your phone has no screen lock now, so Cycle can\'t ask for one and turned its lock off. Everything you logged is still here.
